title: Mrs. Vivien Hidary: "Parashat Haye Sarah"

chapters.title: Introduction to Parashat Hayei Sara
chapters.about: Opening verses and linguistic analysis of Sarah's years

chapters.title: Avraham's Grief and Purchasing the Land
chapters.about: Mourning Sarah, speaking with Bnei Chet, and acquiring Ma'arat HaMachpelah

chapters.title: Sending the Servant for a Wife
chapters.about: Avraham's instructions to his servant regarding Yitzchak's marriage

chapters.title: The Servant's Prayer at the Well
chapters.about: Eliezer arrives at the water source and prays for divine assistance

chapters.title: Meeting Rivka
chapters.about: Rivka's arrival, offering water to the servant and camels

chapters.title: Rivka Meets Yitzchak
chapters.about: Yitzchak and Rivka meet, and she is brought into Sarah's tent

summary: Mrs. Hidary goes through Parashat Hayei Sara, exploring the opening verses concerning Sarah and Avraham's purchase of the Ma'arat HaMachpelah. She then discusses the journey of Avraham's servant to find a wife for Yitzchak and the introduction of Rivka at the well.
questions: What are the lessons behind the way mourning and grief are described after Sarah's passing?
Why did Avraham insist on purchasing the Ma'arat HaMachpelah with full payment?
What character traits does Eliezer demonstrate when praying by the water source?
How does Rivka's arrival at the well mirror the themes of kindness and readiness seen in Avraham?
